items.source: Contract for registering RuntimeHints for integration tests run with the Spring TestContext Framework based on the ClassLoader of the deployment unit.
items.translation: 用于为基于部署单元的 ClassLoader 运行集成测试的 Spring TestContext Framework 注册 RuntimeHints 的合同。

items.source: Strategy interface for loading an ApplicationContext for build-time AOT processing as well as run-time AOT execution for an integration test managed by the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 用于在构建时ApplicationContext加载的 Strategy 接口，同时也支持为受 Spring TestContext Framework 管理的集成测试进行运行时AOT 执行以及 AOT 处理AOT 处理。

items.source: AotTestExecutionListener is an extension of the TestExecutionListener SPI that allows a listener to optionally provide ahead-of-time (AOT) support.
items.translation: AotTestExecutionListener 是 TestExecutionListener SPI 的扩展，允许监听器可选地提供提前编译（AOT）支持。

items.source: @DisabledInAotMode signals that the annotated test class is disabled in Spring AOT (ahead-of-time) mode, which means that the ApplicationContext for the test class will not be processed for AOT optimizations at build time.
items.translation: @DisabledInAotMode 信号表明该注释的测试类在 Spring AOT（提前编译）模式下处于禁用状态，这意味着该测试类的 ApplicationContext 在构建时不会针对 AOT 优化进行处理。

items.source: TestContextAotGenerator generates AOT artifacts for integration tests that depend on support from the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: TestContextAotGenerator 为依赖于 Spring TestContext Framework 支持的集成测试生成 AOT 工件。

items.source: Ahead-of-time (AOT) support for the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的提前编译（AOT）支持。

items.source: This package contains the Spring TestContext Framework which provides annotation-driven unit and integration testing support that is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use.
items.translation: 该包包含Spring TestContext 框架，它提供与所使用的实际测试框架无关的基于注解的单元测试和集成测试支持。

items.source: Holder for metadata specific to ahead-of-time (AOT) support in the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 用于在Spring TestContext Framework中支持提前编译（AOT）的特定元数据的持有者。

items.source: AotTestContextInitializers provides mappings from test classes to AOT-optimized context initializers.
items.translation: AotTestContextInitializers 提供从测试类到 AOT 优化上下文初始化器的映射。

items.source: Thrown if an error occurs during AOT build-time processing or AOT run-time execution in the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: 在Spring TestContext Framework的AOT 构建时处理或 AOT 运行时执行期间发生错误时抛出。

items.source:
Filesystem-based ahead-of-time (AOT) processing base implementation that scans
the provided classpath roots for Spring integration test classes and then
generates AOT artifacts for those test classes in the configured output directories.
items.translation: 基于文件系统的提前编译（AOT）处理基础实现，它会扫描提供的类路径根目录以查找 Spring 集成测试类，然后为这些测试类在配置的输出目录中生成 AOT 工件。
